name: TMG Technologie-Radar: Produzierender Mittelstand
audience: Consultants of TMG Technologie Management Gruppe and their clients: managing directors and heads of production, engineering and quality in manufacturing SMEs (Mittelstand) in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
industry: Manufacturing SMEs in Germany, Austria and Switzerland
description: Weekly technology monitoring for clients of TMG Technologie Management Gruppe: the producing Mittelstand in the DACH region, such as machine and plant builders, automotive and industrial suppliers, and metal, plastics and electronics manufacturers. The radar tracks what these companies should know about AI in production, industrial IoT and edge, robotics and automation, and the EU rules that change how they build, report and sell. Relevance means a concrete consequence for a mid-sized manufacturer: a technology becoming affordable or proven, a vendor move, a funding opportunity, or a regulatory obligation with a deadline.

watch_fields.name: AI in production
watch_fields.description: AI-based quality inspection, predictive maintenance and generative AI on the shop floor: what works in real factories, what it costs, and who offers it.

watch_fields.name: Industrial IoT, edge & Industrie 4.0
watch_fields.description: Connected machines, edge computing, OPC UA and private 5G, digital twins and the data platforms that make Industrie 4.0 work for mid-sized plants.

watch_fields.name: Robotics, cobots & automation
watch_fields.description: Industrial and collaborative robots, mobile robots, humanoids and automation that a mid-sized plant can deploy against labour shortage and cost pressure.

watch_fields.name: Regulation & sustainability for manufacturers
watch_fields.description: CBAM, CSRD, the EU AI Act, the Machinery Regulation, the Cyber Resilience Act and the digital product passport: deadlines, obligations and costs for manufacturers.
